name: h2-connection-send-buffer
instr:
Please add a hard connection-wide outbound DATA budget to h2 in `/app`, including exclusive per-stream credit so producers can hold space before preparing buffers. Don't add new crates.

Add builder methods `h2::client::Builder::max_connection_send_buffer_size(&mut self, max: usize) -> &mut Self` and `h2::server::Builder::max_connection_send_buffer_size(&mut self, max: usize) -> &mut Self`, default `usize::MAX`, allowing zero. Add connection methods `h2::client::Connection::set_max_connection_send_buffer_size(&mut self, max: usize)` and `h2::server::Connection::set_max_connection_send_buffer_size(&mut self, max: usize)`. Each connection independently shares its budget across requests, responses, pushes and cloned handles. Resizing wakes waiters and retains queued bytes and credits, even above the new limit.

On `h2::SendStream<B>` where `B: bytes::Buf`, add methods:
- `h2::SendStream::connection_send_buffer_remaining(&self) -> usize`
- `h2::SendStream::reserve_send_buffer(&mut self, len: usize) -> Result<(), h2::Error>`
- `h2::SendStream::reserved_send_buffer(&self) -> usize`
- `h2::SendStream::poll_send_buffer(&mut self, cx: &mut std::task::Context<'_>, len: usize) -> std::task::Poll<Result<(), h2::Error>>`
- `h2::SendStream::try_send_data(&mut self, data: B, end_of_stream: bool) -> Result<(), (h2::Error, B)>`

Remaining space is the limit minus queued payload bytes and unused credits, saturating at zero, readable after closure. Reservations replace, not add to, that stream'
